structured_output.mechanisms: Time ≈ fixed 0.1 s + steps × (2 ms per-step overhead + per-sample cost from conv FLOPs across the three blocks, scaled by pixel count in low-res phases, + Muon overhead). Steps come from epochs, not the train_steps field. Accuracy saturates with epochs and width, and falls off sharply with low-res fraction. Cutout, random flip, large translate, and extreme label smoothing each cost accuracy. Muon adds about +1%.
